findings.claim: The plan leaves out the decisions index entry for ADR 0012, which repeats the same stale claim P1 is about: `.okf/decisions/index.md` line 28 ends `(amended: apm/apm.yml is the one version source)`. That path is gone, and kmaudit has its own version source. A reader reaches the index before the ADR, so fixing only the ADR leaves the wrong claim in place and G1 unmet. O1's `touches` should add `.okf/decisions/index.md`, and also `tests/scripts/test_release_docs.py`, where the new test that `checked by` describes will live. The prose and outcome should say the index note changes, for example to name both packages' apm.yml files and ADR 0045.
The plan missed .okf/decisions/index.md's note on ADR 0012 and left the test file out of touches.

ADR 0020's Decision still says kmctl's package is three APM packages in apm/ (apm/, apm/claude/, apm/antigravity/), and ADR 0011's last rule-path correction puts the rules in apm/claude/.apm/instructions/ and apm/antigravity/.apm/instructions/. Neither has a correction pointing at ADR 0045, and packages/kmctl/apm now holds those sub-packages. G1 ("the decisions describe where each package's APM package lives today") and P1 claim more than O1 covers, so after this plan ships the decisions still give apm/ as the package's current home.
